verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic-search runtime, and such a product could plausibly offer user-configurable background jobs such as scheduled re-crawls or syncs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only on-demand SDK, CLI and API operations (web-source crawling, upserts, cloud hot-swaps) and tools that other agents can call. Nothing shows users setting up automations that run on their own in the background.
